SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON_GALAR.dex: Its restlessness has it constantly moving in zigzags. It will purposely run into other Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.

SPECIES_LINOONE_GALAR.name: LINOONE-G
SPECIES_LINOONE_GALAR.dex: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself. It uses its long tongue to taunt them to then tackle forcefully.

SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.name: OBSTAGOON
SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.dex: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout--this move is known as Obstruct.

SPECIES_WURMPLE.name: WURMPLE
SPECIES_WURMPLE.dex: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

SPECIES_SILCOON.name: SILCOON
SPECIES_SILCOON.dex: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.name: BEAUTIFLY
SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.dex: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

SPECIES_CASCOON.name: CASCOON
SPECIES_CASCOON.dex: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

SPECIES_DUSTOX.name: DUSTOX
SPECIES_DUSTOX.dex: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

SPECIES_LOTAD.name: LOTAD
SPECIES_LOTAD.dex: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

SPECIES_LOMBRE.name: LOMBRE
SPECIES_LOMBRE.dex: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

SPECIES_LUDICOLO.name: LUDICOLO
SPECIES_LUDICOLO.dex: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

SPECIES_SEEDOT.name: SEEDOT
SPECIES_SEEDOT.dex: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

SPECIES_NUZLEAF.name: NUZLEAF
SPECIES_NUZLEAF.dex: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

SPECIES_SHIFTRY.name: SHIFTRY
SPECIES_SHIFTRY.dex: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

SPECIES_TAILLOW.name: TAILLOW
SPECIES_TAILLOW.dex: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

SPECIES_SWELLOW.name: SWELLOW
SPECIES_SWELLOW.dex: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

SPECIES_WINGULL.name: WINGULL
SPECIES_WINGULL.dex: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

SPECIES_PELIPPER.name: PELIPPER
SPECIES_PELIPPER.dex: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

SPECIES_RALTS.name: RALTS
SPECIES_RALTS.dex: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

SPECIES_KIRLIA.name: KIRLIA
SPECIES_KIRLIA.dex: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create  a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.name: GARDEVOIR
SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.dex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

SPECIES_GARDEVOIR_MEGA.name: GARDEVOIR
SPECIES_GARDEVOIR_MEGA.dex: By opening its heart, Mega Gardevoir becomes able to use tremendous psychic power. The red plate in its chest is said to be a physical manifestation of its heart.

SPECIES_GALLADE.name: GALLADE
SPECIES_GALLADE.dex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

SPECIES_GALLADE_MEGA.name: GALLADE
SPECIES_GALLADE_MEGA.dex: Mega Gallade has a knightly appearance. It can use its psychic power to reshape both arms into blades simultaneously and fight using a dual-wielding style.

SPECIES_SURSKIT.name: SURSKIT
SPECIES_SURSKIT.dex: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.name: MASQUERAIN
SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.dex: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

SPECIES_SHROOMISH.name: SHROOMISH
SPECIES_SHROOMISH.dex: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.

SPECIES_BRELOOM.name: BRELOOM
SPECIES_BRELOOM.dex: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

SPECIES_SLAKOTH.name: SLAKOTH
SPECIES_SLAKOTH.dex: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

SPECIES_VIGOROTH.name: VIGOROTH
SPECIES_VIGOROTH.dex: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

SPECIES_SLAKING.name: SLAKING
SPECIES_SLAKING.dex: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

SPECIES_NINCADA.name: NINCADA
SPECIES_NINCADA.dex: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

SPECIES_NINJASK.name: NINJASK
SPECIES_NINJASK.dex: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

SPECIES_SHEDINJA.name: SHEDINJA
SPECIES_SHEDINJA.dex: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

SPECIES_WHISMUR.name: WHISMUR
SPECIES_WHISMUR.dex: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

SPECIES_LOUDRED.name: LOUDRED
SPECIES_LOUDRED.dex: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

SPECIES_EXPLOUD.name: EXPLOUD
SPECIES_EXPLOUD.dex: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

SPECIES_MAKUHITA.name: MAKUHITA
SPECIES_MAKUHITA.dex: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

SPECIES_HARIYAMA.name: HARIYAMA
SPECIES_HARIYAMA.dex: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

SPECIES_NOSEPASS.name: NOSEPASS
SPECIES_NOSEPASS.dex: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

SPECIES_PROBOPASS.name: PROBOPASS
SPECIES_PROBOPASS.dex: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack its foes from three directions.

SPECIES_SKITTY.name: SKITTY
SPECIES_SKITTY.dex: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

SPECIES_DELCATTY.name: DELCATTY
SPECIES_DELCATTY.dex: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

SPECIES_SABLEYE.name: SABLEYE
SPECIES_SABLEYE.dex: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

SPECIES_SABLEYE_MEGA.name: SABLEYE
SPECIES_SABLEYE_MEGA.dex: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, the gemstone on its chest expands, rips through its skin, and falls out.

SPECIES_MAWILE.name: MAWILE
SPECIES_MAWILE.dex: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

SPECIES_MAWILE_MEGA.name: MAWILE
SPECIES_MAWILE_MEGA.dex: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

SPECIES_ARON.name: ARON
SPECIES_ARON.dex: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

SPECIES_LAIRON.name: LAIRON
SPECIES_LAIRON.dex: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

SPECIES_AGGRON.name: AGGRON
SPECIES_AGGRON.dex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

SPECIES_AGGRON_MEGA.name: AGGRON
SPECIES_AGGRON_MEGA.dex: When Aggron Mega Evolves into Mega Aggron, the destructive ability of its fearsome horns can turn a steel-clad tank into so much scrap metal.

SPECIES_MEDITITE.name: MEDITITE
SPECIES_MEDITITE.dex: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

SPECIES_MEDICHAM.name: MEDICHAM
SPECIES_MEDICHAM.dex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

SPECIES_MEDICHAM_MEGA.name: MEDICHAM
SPECIES_MEDICHAM_MEGA.dex: It uses its amped-up willpower to create additional arms for itself. The more it has trained its spirit, the more realistic and dexterous these arms become.

SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.name: ELECTRIKE
SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.dex: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

SPECIES_MANECTRIC.name: MANECTRIC
SPECIES_MANECTRIC.dex: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

SPECIES_MANECTRIC_MEGA.name: MANECTRIC
SPECIES_MANECTRIC_MEGA.dex: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

SPECIES_PLUSLE.name: PLUSLE
SPECIES_PLUSLE.dex: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

SPECIES_MINUN.name: MINUN
SPECIES_MINUN.dex: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

SPECIES_VOLBEAT.name: VOLBEAT
SPECIES_VOLBEAT.dex: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

SPECIES_ILLUMISE.name: ILLUMISE
SPECIES_ILLUMISE.dex: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

SPECIES_BUDEW.name: BUDEW
SPECIES_BUDEW.dex: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun's warm touch.

SPECIES_ROSELIA.name: ROSELIA
SPECIES_ROSELIA.dex: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

SPECIES_ROSERADE.name: ROSERADE
SPECIES_ROSERADE.dex: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

SPECIES_GULPIN.name: GULPIN
SPECIES_GULPIN.dex: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

SPECIES_SWALOT.name: SWALOT
SPECIES_SWALOT.dex: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

SPECIES_CARVANHA.name: CARVANHA
SPECIES_CARVANHA.dex: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

SPECIES_SHARPEDO.name: SHARPEDO
SPECIES_SHARPEDO.dex: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

SPECIES_SHARPEDO_MEGA.name: SHARPEDO
SPECIES_SHARPEDO_MEGA.dex: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

SPECIES_WAILMER.name: WAILMER
SPECIES_WAILMER.dex: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

SPECIES_WAILORD.name: WAILORD
SPECIES_WAILORD.dex: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

SPECIES_NUMEL.name: NUMEL
SPECIES_NUMEL.dex: A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

SPECIES_CAMERUPT.name: CAMERUPT
SPECIES_CAMERUPT.dex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

SPECIES_CAMERUPT_MEGA.name: CAMERUPT
SPECIES_CAMERUPT_MEGA.dex: The humps on its back have transformed into one large and very active volcano. It has a deep hatred of water or any moisture and has an explosive personality.

SPECIES_TORKOAL.name: TORKOAL
SPECIES_TORKOAL.dex: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

SPECIES_SPOINK.name: SPOINK
SPECIES_SPOINK.dex: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

SPECIES_GRUMPIG.name: GRUMPIG
SPECIES_GRUMPIG.dex: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

SPECIES_SPINDA.name: SPINDA
SPECIES_SPINDA.dex: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

SPECIES_TRAPINCH.name: TRAPINCH
SPECIES_TRAPINCH.dex: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

SPECIES_VIBRAVA.name: VIBRAVA
SPECIES_VIBRAVA.dex: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

SPECIES_FLYGON.name: FLYGON
SPECIES_FLYGON.dex: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

SPECIES_CACNEA.name: CACNEA
SPECIES_CACNEA.dex: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

SPECIES_CACTURNE.name: CACTURNE
SPECIES_CACTURNE.dex: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

SPECIES_SWABLU.name: SWABLU
SPECIES_SWABLU.dex: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

SPECIES_ALTARIA.name: ALTARIA
SPECIES_ALTARIA.dex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

SPECIES_ALTARIA_MEGA.name: ALTARIA
SPECIES_ALTARIA_MEGA.dex: It sings with a voice that is even more beautiful than before it Mega Evolved. Its feathers became larger for protection and glimmer with an iridescent sheen.

SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.name: ZANGOOSE
SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.dex: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

SPECIES_SEVIPER.name: SEVIPER
SPECIES_SEVIPER.dex: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

SPECIES_BARBOACH.name: BARBOACH
SPECIES_BARBOACH.dex: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.

SPECIES_WHISCASH.name: WHISCASH
SPECIES_WHISCASH.dex: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

SPECIES_CORPHISH.name: CORPHISH
SPECIES_CORPHISH.dex: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.name: CRAWDAUNT
SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.dex: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

SPECIES_BALTOY.name: BALTOY
SPECIES_BALTOY.dex: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals  adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

SPECIES_CLAYDOL.name: CLAYDOL
SPECIES_CLAYDOL.dex: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.

SPECIES_LILEEP.name: LILEEP
SPECIES_LILEEP.dex: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.

SPECIES_CRADILY.name: CRADILY
SPECIES_CRADILY.dex: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

SPECIES_ANORITH.name: ANORITH
SPECIES_ANORITH.dex: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

SPECIES_ARMALDO.name: ARMALDO
SPECIES_ARMALDO.dex: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

SPECIES_FEEBAS.name: FEEBAS
SPECIES_FEEBAS.dex: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.

SPECIES_MILOTIC.name: MILOTIC
SPECIES_MILOTIC.dex: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.name: CASTFORM
SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.dex: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.name: CASTFORM
SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.dex: Castform takes this form on bright days. In an experiment where is was placed in front of a heater, it didn't change to this form. Its body is warm and toasty.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.name: CASTFORM
SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.dex: This is Castform's form while it's raining. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, it didn't change to this form. Its body is soft, slightly swollen with water.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.name: CASTFORM
SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.dex: This is Castform's form in a hailstorm. In an experiment where it was placed in a freezer, it didn't change to this form. Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.

SPECIES_KECLEON.name: KECLEON
SPECIES_KECLEON.dex: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

SPECIES_SHUPPET.name: SHUPPET
SPECIES_SHUPPET.dex: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

SPECIES_BANETTE.name: BANETTE
SPECIES_BANETTE.dex: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

SPECIES_BANETTE_MEGA.name: BANETTE
SPECIES_BANETTE_MEGA.dex: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

SPECIES_DUSKULL.name: DUSKULL
SPECIES_DUSKULL.dex: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.name: DUSCLOPS
SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.dex: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.name: DUSKNOIR
SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.dex: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits into its pliant body and guides them home.

SPECIES_TROPIUS.name: TROPIUS
SPECIES_TROPIUS.dex: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

SPECIES_CHINGLING.name: CHINGLING
SPECIES_CHINGLING.dex: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound. It can cry for an awfully long time.

SPECIES_CHIMECHO_MEGA.name: CHIMECHO
SPECIES_CHIMECHO_MEGA.dex: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.

SPECIES_ABSOL.name: ABSOL
SPECIES_ABSOL.dex: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA.name: ABSOL
SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA.dex: As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it, its fur bristles. What you see on its back are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't able to fly.

SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA_Z.name: ABSOL
SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA_Z.dex: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

SPECIES_SNORUNT.name: SNORUNT
SPECIES_SNORUNT.dex: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

SPECIES_GLALIE.name: GLALIE
SPECIES_GLALIE.dex: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

SPECIES_GLALIE_MEGA.name: GLALIE
SPECIES_GLALIE_MEGA.dex: The power of Mega Evolution was so strong that it smashed Glalie's jaw. Its inability to eat very well leaves Glalie irritated.

SPECIES_FROSLASS.name: FROSLASS
SPECIES_FROSLASS.dex: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

SPECIES_FROSLASS_MEGA.name: FROSLASS
SPECIES_FROSLASS_MEGA.dex: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.

SPECIES_SPHEAL.name: SPHEAL
SPECIES_SPHEAL.dex: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

SPECIES_SEALEO.name: SEALEO
SPECIES_SEALEO.dex: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

SPECIES_WALREIN.name: WALREIN
SPECIES_WALREIN.dex: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

SPECIES_CLAMPERL.name: CLAMPERL
SPECIES_CLAMPERL.dex: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

SPECIES_HUNTAIL.name: HUNTAIL
SPECIES_HUNTAIL.dex: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

SPECIES_GOREBYSS.name: GOREBYSS
SPECIES_GOREBYSS.dex: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

SPECIES_RELICANTH.name: RELICANTH
SPECIES_RELICANTH.dex: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

SPECIES_LUVDISC.name: LUVDISC
SPECIES_LUVDISC.dex: Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to express one's feelings of love.

SPECIES_BAGON.name: BAGON
SPECIES_BAGON.dex: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

SPECIES_SHELGON.name: SHELGON
SPECIES_SHELGON.dex: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

SPECIES_SALAMENCE.name: SALAMENCE
SPECIES_SALAMENCE.dex: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

SPECIES_SALAMENCE_MEGA.name: SALAMENCE
SPECIES_SALAMENCE_MEGA.dex: Mega Evolution fuels its brutality, and it may even turn on the Trainer who raised it. It's been dubbed the blood-soaked. crescent.

SPECIES_BELDUM.name: BELDUM
SPECIES_BELDUM.dex: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

SPECIES_METANG.name: METANG
SPECIES_METANG.dex: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

SPECIES_METAGROSS.name: METAGROSS
SPECIES_METAGROSS.dex: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

SPECIES_METAGROSS_MEGA.name: METAGROSS
SPECIES_METAGROSS_MEGA.dex: When it knows it can't win, it digs the claws on its legs into its opponent and starts the countdown to a big explosion.

SPECIES_REGIROCK.name: REGIROCK
SPECIES_REGIROCK.dex: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.

SPECIES_REGICE.name: REGICE
SPECIES_REGICE.dex: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.

SPECIES_REGISTEEL.name: REGISTEEL
SPECIES_REGISTEEL.dex: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

SPECIES_LATIAS.name: LATIAS
SPECIES_LATIAS.dex: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

SPECIES_LATIAS_MEGA.name: LATIAS
SPECIES_LATIAS_MEGA.dex: Its body is smaller than Mega Latios's body. It is more agile and can make very sharp turns. When it Mega Evolves, its defensive strength grows substantially.

SPECIES_LATIOS.name: LATIOS
SPECIES_LATIOS.dex: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

SPECIES_LATIOS_MEGA.name: LATIOS
SPECIES_LATIOS_MEGA.dex: It's larger than Mega Latias, and can achieve higher speeds in flight. This Pokémon can use its speed in battle to unleash a flurry of attacks.

SPECIES_KYOGRE.name: KYOGRE
SPECIES_KYOGRE.dex: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.name: KYOGRE
SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.dex: When Kyogre roared, water poured forth and the seas spread outward. Dark clouds enshrouded the world, and the deluge fell upon all…

SPECIES_GROUDON.name: GROUDON
SPECIES_GROUDON.dex: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.name: GROUDON
SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.dex: When Groudon howled, the earth swelled and the land grew wide. The sun blazed atop and all the world around the creature was enveloped in incandescent heat.

SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.name: RAYQUAZA
SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.dex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.name: RAYQUAZA
SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.dex: Particles stream from the filaments that extend from its jaw. They can control the density and humidity of the air, allowing Rayquaza to manipulate the weather.

SPECIES_JIRACHI.name: JIRACHI
SPECIES_JIRACHI.dex: Jirachi is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.

SPECIES_DEOXYS_NORMAL.name: DEOXYS
SPECIES_DEOXYS_NORMAL.dex: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and can shoot lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

SPECIES_DEOXYS_ATTACK.name: DEOXYS
SPECIES_DEOXYS_ATTACK.dex: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

SPECIES_DEOXYS_DEFENSE.name: DEOXYS
SPECIES_DEOXYS_DEFENSE.dex: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.

SPECIES_DEOXYS_SPEED.name: DEOXYS
SPECIES_DEOXYS_SPEED.dex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior  agility and speed.

SPECIES_TURTWIG.name: TURTWIG
SPECIES_TURTWIG.dex: The shell on its back is made of soil.  On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell  should feel moist. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

SPECIES_GROTLE.name: GROTLE
SPECIES_GROTLE.dex: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater well.  It carries fellow Pokémon there on  its back.

SPECIES_TORTERRA.name: TORTERRA
SPECIES_TORTERRA.dex: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there. Ancient people imagined that beneath  the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.name: CHIMCHAR
SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.dex: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Before going to sleep, Chimchar extinguish the flame on their tails to prevent fires.

SPECIES_MONFERNO.name: MONFERNO
SPECIES_MONFERNO.dex: It carefully controls the intensity of the flame on its tail, so as to keep its foes at an adequate distance. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

SPECIES_INFERNAPE.name: INFERNAPE
SPECIES_INFERNAPE.dex: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all of its limbs to take on any opponent.

SPECIES_PIPLUP.name: PIPLUP
SPECIES_PIPLUP.dex: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

SPECIES_PRINPLUP.name: PRINPLUP
SPECIES_PRINPLUP.dex: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group. It searches for prey in icy seas.

SPECIES_EMPOLEON.name: EMPOLEON
SPECIES_EMPOLEON.dex: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

SPECIES_STARLY.name: STARLY
SPECIES_STARLY.dex: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. However, they bicker if the group grows too big. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

SPECIES_STARAVIA.name: STARAVIA
SPECIES_STARAVIA.dex: Recognizing their own weakness, they maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles break out between various flocks. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

SPECIES_STARAPTOR.name: STARAPTOR
SPECIES_STARAPTOR.dex: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

SPECIES_STARAPTOR_MEGA.name: STARAPTOR
SPECIES_STARAPTOR_MEGA.dex: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.

SPECIES_BIDOOF.name: BIDOOF
SPECIES_BIDOOF.dex: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's. It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth.

SPECIES_BIBAREL.name: BIBAREL
SPECIES_BIBAREL.dex: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

SPECIES_KRICKETOT.name: KRICKETOT
SPECIES_KRICKETOT.dex: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.name: KRICKETUNE
SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.dex: It signals its emotions with its melodies. There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

SPECIES_SHINX.name: SHINX
SPECIES_SHINX.dex: It rapidly contracts and relaxes its muscles to generate electricity. Its body shines if endangered. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

SPECIES_LUXIO.name: LUXIO
SPECIES_LUXIO.dex: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch has enough amperage to cause fainting in foes.

SPECIES_LUXRAY.name: LUXRAY
SPECIES_LUXRAY.dex: It has eyes which can see through anything. Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

SPECIES_CRANIDOS.name: CRANIDOS
SPECIES_CRANIDOS.dex: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, its skull is as hard as iron.  It would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.

SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.name: RAMPARDOS
SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.dex: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos's.

SPECIES_SHIELDON.name: SHIELDON
SPECIES_SHIELDON.dex: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

SPECIES_BASTIODON.name: BASTIODON
SPECIES_BASTIODON.dex: Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from any frontral attacks. When attacked, they form a wall. They shielded their young in that way.

SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.name: BURMY
SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.dex: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it will immediately repair it with whatever is near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.name: BURMY
SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.dex: It weaves a cloak together with sand, mud, and silk it spits out. This earthen cloak is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon hides away in caves and other such places.

SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.name: BURMY
SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.dex: When confronted by a lack of other materials, Burmy will create its cloak using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to be more comfortable than one would think.

SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.name: WORMADAM
SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.dex: Its appearance changes depending on where Burmy evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body. The cloak is never shed.

SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.name: WORMADAM
SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.dex: Its earthen skin is reasonably hard, it has no problem repelling a Starly's pecking. It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.name: WORMADAM
SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.dex: Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to the scenery enough to be inconspicuous. This seems to be the perfect way for it to evade the detection of predators.

SPECIES_COMBEE.name: COMBEE
SPECIES_COMBEE.dex: A Pokémon formed by three others. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.name: VESPIQUEN
SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.dex: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding. There is only one in a colony.

SPECIES_PACHIRISU.name: PACHIRISU
SPECIES_PACHIRISU.dex: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

SPECIES_BUIZEL.name: BUIZEL
SPECIES_BUIZEL.dex: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement. It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.

SPECIES_FLOATZEL.name: FLOATZEL
SPECIES_FLOATZEL.dex: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

SPECIES_CHERUBI.name: CHERUBI
SPECIES_CHERUBI.dex: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is also very sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and Taillow try to peck it off.

SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.name: CHERRIM
SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.dex: It's motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.name: CHERRIM
SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.dex: Cherrim takes this form on sunny days. Its faint scent entices bug Pokémon to it. It immediately closes its petals and becomes immobile once the sun hides.

SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.name: SHELLOS
SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.dex: It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies. While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky. Apparently, there are more West Sea Shellos now than there were in the past.

SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.name: SHELLOS
SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.dex: It's capable of spending a limited amount of time on land until their skin dries out. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.name: GASTRODON
SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.dex: It appears on shallow-water beaches to eat sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will ensue.

SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.name: GASTRODON
SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.dex: Found more often on land than in the sea. They normally live in rocky seashores, but when cloudy or rainy, they can sometimes be found on mountains, far from the sea.

SPECIES_DRIFLOON.name: DRIFLOON
SPECIES_DRIFLOON.dex: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.

SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.name: DRIFBLIM
SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.dex: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view. No one knows where they go.

SPECIES_BUNEARY.name: BUNEARY
SPECIES_BUNEARY.dex: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it's scared, both ears are rolled up. When it senses danger, it perks them up.

SPECIES_LOPUNNY.name: LOPUNNY
SPECIES_LOPUNNY.dex: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

SPECIES_LOPUNNY_MEGA.name: LOPUNNY
SPECIES_LOPUNNY_MEGA.dex: Mega Evolution awakens its combative instincts. It has shed any fur that got in the way of its attacks. crescent.

SPECIES_GLAMEOW.name: GLAMEOW
SPECIES_GLAMEOW.dex: It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is  very popular among some. It claws its Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and purrs when affectionate.

SPECIES_PURUGLY.name: PURUGLY
SPECIES_PURUGLY.dex: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own. It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger.

SPECIES_STUNKY.name: STUNKY
SPECIES_STUNKY.dex: It protects itself by spraying a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

SPECIES_SKUNTANK.name: SKUNTANK
SPECIES_SKUNTANK.dex: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

SPECIES_BRONZOR.name: BRONZOR
SPECIES_BRONZOR.dex: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

SPECIES_BRONZONG.name: BRONZONG
SPECIES_BRONZONG.dex: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2000-year sleep.

SPECIES_CHATOT.name: CHATOT
SPECIES_CHATOT.dex: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it. It can also learn and speak human words.

SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.name: SPIRITOMB
SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.dex: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

SPECIES_GIBLE.name: GIBLE
SPECIES_GIBLE.dex: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who stray too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

SPECIES_GABITE.name: GABITE
SPECIES_GABITE.dex: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

SPECIES_GARCHOMP.name: GARCHOMP
SPECIES_GARCHOMP.dex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA.name: GARCHOMP
SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA.dex: Excess energy melted its arms and wings into giant scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA_Z.name: GARCHOMP
SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA_Z.dex: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

SPECIES_RIOLU.name: RIOLU
SPECIES_RIOLU.dex: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

SPECIES_LUCARIO.name: LUCARIO
SPECIES_LUCARIO.dex: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA.name: LUCARIO
SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA.dex: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA_Z.name: LUCARIO
SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA_Z.dex: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.name: HIPPOPOTAS
SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.dex: Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when travelling through sand. Instead of perspiration, it expels grains of sand from its body.

SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.name: HIPPOWDON
SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.dex: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength and raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

SPECIES_SKORUPI.name: SKORUPI
SPECIES_SKORUPI.dex: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes. It can survive a year without food.

SPECIES_DRAPION.name: DRAPION
SPECIES_DRAPION.dex: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap out of a car.

SPECIES_CROAGUNK.name: CROAGUNK
SPECIES_CROAGUNK.dex: Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

SPECIES_TOXICROAK.name: TOXICROAK
SPECIES_TOXICROAK.dex: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

SPECIES_CARNIVINE.name: CARNIVINE
SPECIES_CARNIVINE.dex: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.

SPECIES_FINNEON.name: FINNEON
SPECIES_FINNEON.dex: Its double tail fins propel its energetic jumps. When it breaks the surface of the sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on the fly.

SPECIES_LUMINEON.name: LUMINEON
SPECIES_LUMINEON.dex: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky. It competes for food with Lanturn.

SPECIES_SNOVER.name: SNOVER
SPECIES_SNOVER.dex: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.name: ABOMASNOW
SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.dex: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

SPECIES_ABOMASNOW_MEGA.name: ABOMASNOW
SPECIES_ABOMASNOW_MEGA.dex: The sprouts on Abomasnow's back grow into great shafts of ice when it Mega Evolves. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep in mountains.

SPECIES_ROTOM.name: ROTOM
SPECIES_ROTOM.dex: Its body is composed of plasma and loves to surprise others. One boy's invention led to the development of many machines that can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.

SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.name: ROTOM
SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.dex: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic. It makes mischief by turning up the heat.

SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.name: ROTOM
SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.dex: It enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. The model of washing machine that Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued, so they are now traded at high prices.

SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.name: ROTOM
SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.dex: In this form, Rotom likes to play freezing cold pranks. You may find it's turned the bath you just filled to solid ice! It battles by spewing cold air.

SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.name: ROTOM
SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.dex: The first appliance developed that Rotom coud inspirit was the electric fan. It uses its power over wind in its pranks, happily blowing any important documents it finds.

SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.name: ROTOM
SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.dex: The lawn mower is an appliance that led to the development of the Rotom Dex. It will mow down grass and flowers, then swagger around with pride at its accomplishments.

SPECIES_UXIE.name: UXIE
SPECIES_UXIE.dex: Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,” according to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

SPECIES_MESPRIT.name: MESPRIT
SPECIES_MESPRIT.dex: Although it slumbers at the bottom of a lake, its spirit is said to leave its body and flitter on the water surface. It taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.

SPECIES_AZELF.name: AZELF
SPECIES_AZELF.dex: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

SPECIES_DIALGA.name: DIALGA
SPECIES_DIALGA.dex: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.name: DIALGA
SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.dex: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. It wields such a colossal strength that this might be its true form.

SPECIES_PALKIA.name: PALKIA
SPECIES_PALKIA.dex: Palkia has the ability to distort space. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places and other dimensions.

SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.name: PALKIA
SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.dex: It soars across the sky in a form that resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is a strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

SPECIES_HEATRAN.name: HEATRAN
SPECIES_HEATRAN.dex: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It dwells in volcanic caves, using its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

SPECIES_HEATRAN_MEGA.name: HEATRAN
SPECIES_HEATRAN_MEGA.dex: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.name: REGIGIGAS
SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.dex: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon shaped Regirock, Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice, and magma.

SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.name: GIRATINA
SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.dex: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange. It was banished for its violence.

SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.name: GIRATINA
SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.dex: Giratina loses its legs upon changing into this form. It's believed it hails from a world where the heavens and the earth are as one.

SPECIES_CRESSELIA.name: CRESSELIA
SPECIES_CRESSELIA.dex: Those who sleep holding one of Cresselia's feathers are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

SPECIES_PHIONE.name: PHIONE
SPECIES_PHIONE.dex: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs. It always returns to where it was born.

SPECIES_MANAPHY.name: MANAPHY
SPECIES_MANAPHY.dex: Water makes up 80% of its body. It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

SPECIES_DARKRAI.name: DARKRAI
SPECIES_DARKRAI.dex: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers. However, it means no harm.

SPECIES_DARKRAI_MEGA.name: DARKRAI
SPECIES_DARKRAI_MEGA.dex: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.

SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.name: SHAYMIN
SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.dex: The flowers all over its body bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It dissolves toxins in the air to transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.name: SHAYMIN
SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.dex: Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light and its tiny body transforms, confering the power of flight upon it.

SPECIES_VICTINI.name: VICTINI
SPECIES_VICTINI.dex: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

SPECIES_SNIVY.name: SNIVY
SPECIES_SNIVY.dex: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

SPECIES_SERVINE.name: SERVINE
SPECIES_SERVINE.dex: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage.

SPECIES_SERPERIOR.name: SERPERIOR
SPECIES_SERPERIOR.dex: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

SPECIES_TEPIG.name: TEPIG
SPECIES_TEPIG.dex: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It blows fire through its nose.

SPECIES_PIGNITE.name: PIGNITE
SPECIES_PIGNITE.dex: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

SPECIES_EMBOAR.name: EMBOAR
SPECIES_EMBOAR.dex: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

SPECIES_EMBOAR_MEGA.name: EMBOAR
SPECIES_EMBOAR_MEGA.dex: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to save its imperiled allies.

SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.name: OSHAWOTT
SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.dex: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

SPECIES_DEWOTT.name: DEWOTT
SPECIES_DEWOTT.dex: Strict training and disclipine leads it to master its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another.

SPECIES_SAMUROTT.name: SAMUROTT
SPECIES_SAMUROTT.dex: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

SPECIES_SAMUROTT_HISUI.name: SAMUROTT-H
SPECIES_SAMUROTT_HISUI.dex: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui.

SPECIES_PATRAT.name: PATRAT
SPECIES_PATRAT.dex: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days.

SPECIES_WATCHOG.name: WATCHOG
SPECIES_WATCHOG.dex: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

SPECIES_LILLIPUP.name: LILLIPUP
SPECIES_LILLIPUP.dex: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

SPECIES_HERDIER.name: HERDIER
SPECIES_HERDIER.dex: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

SPECIES_STOUTLAND.name: STOUTLAND
SPECIES_STOUTLAND.dex: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

SPECIES_PURRLOIN.name: PURRLOIN
SPECIES_PURRLOIN.dex: Their deceptively cute act is the perfect ruse. They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them.

SPECIES_LIEPARD.name: LIEPARD
SPECIES_LIEPARD.dex: Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. They run silently in the night.

SPECIES_PANSAGE.name: PANSAGE
SPECIES_PANSAGE.dex: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

SPECIES_SIMISAGE.name: SIMISAGE
SPECIES_SIMISAGE.dex: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

SPECIES_PANSEAR.name: PANSEAR
SPECIES_PANSEAR.dex: The fire within the tuft on its head can reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

SPECIES_SIMISEAR.name: SIMISEAR
SPECIES_SIMISEAR.dex: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

SPECIES_PANPOUR.name: PANPOUR
SPECIES_PANPOUR.dex: The water stored inside the tuft of its head is rich in nutrients. It waters plants using its tail, plants that receive its water grow large.

SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.name: SIMIPOUR
SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.dex: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

SPECIES_MUNNA.name: MUNNA
SPECIES_MUNNA.dex: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams. Munna always float in the air.

SPECIES_MUSHARNA.name: MUSHARNA
SPECIES_MUSHARNA.dex: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. It changes into different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

SPECIES_PIDOVE.name: PIDOVE
SPECIES_PIDOVE.dex: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

SPECIES_TRANQUILL.name: TRANQUILL
SPECIES_TRANQUILL.dex: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it can always return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance.

SPECIES_UNFEZANT.name: UNFEZANT
SPECIES_UNFEZANT.dex: Males have plumage on their heads. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males. They will only let themselves feel close to their Trainers.

SPECIES_BLITZLE.name: BLITZLE
SPECIES_BLITZLE.dex: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate with one another.

SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.name: ZEBSTRIKA
SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.dex: When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates. It is dangerous when it's angry as it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.name: ROGGENROLA
SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.dex: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

SPECIES_BOLDORE.name: BOLDORE
SPECIES_BOLDORE.dex: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks. When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

SPECIES_GIGALITH.name: GIGALITH
SPECIES_GIGALITH.dex: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

SPECIES_SWOOBAT.name: SWOOBAT
SPECIES_SWOOBAT.dex: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

SPECIES_DRILBUR.name: DRILBUR
SPECIES_DRILBUR.dex: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph by spinning its body. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

SPECIES_EXCADRILL.name: EXCADRILL
SPECIES_EXCADRILL.dex: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels, but it can also help with construction.

SPECIES_EXCADRILL_MEGA.name: EXCADRILL
SPECIES_EXCADRILL_MEGA.dex: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

SPECIES_AUDINO.name: AUDINO
SPECIES_AUDINO.dex: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

SPECIES_AUDINO_MEGA.name: AUDINO
SPECIES_AUDINO_MEGA.dex: Mega Audino emits a soothing pulse from its body that reduces hostility in others. Anything that comes into contact with its second feelers will fall into a deep sleep.

SPECIES_TIMBURR.name: TIMBURR
SPECIES_TIMBURR.dex: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

SPECIES_GURDURR.name: GURDURR
SPECIES_GURDURR.dex: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

SPECIES_CONKELDURR.name: CONKELDURR
SPECIES_CONKELDURR.dex: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. Rather than rely solely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

SPECIES_TYMPOLE.name: TYMPOLE
SPECIES_TYMPOLE.dex: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

SPECIES_PALPITOAD.name: PALPITOAD
SPECIES_PALPITOAD.dex: It lives in the water and on land. When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.name: SEISMITOAD
SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.dex: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. They can also shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.

SPECIES_THROH.name: THROH
SPECIES_THROH.dex: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts. It changes belts as it gets more powerful.

SPECIES_SAWK.name: SAWK
SPECIES_SAWK.dex: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train. Disturbing their training angers them.

SPECIES_SEWADDLE.name: SEWADDLE
SPECIES_SEWADDLE.dex: It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth. Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes, it is a mascot for fashion designers.

SPECIES_SWADLOON.name: SWADLOON
SPECIES_SWADLOON.dex: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

SPECIES_LEAVANNY.name: LEAVANNY
SPECIES_LEAVANNY.dex: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by using the silk secreted from its mouth.

SPECIES_VENIPEDE.name: VENIPEDE
SPECIES_VENIPEDE.dex: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.name: WHIRLIPEDE
SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.dex: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But when attacked, it spins its body at high speed like a wheel and then crashes furiously into its opponent.

SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.name: SCOLIPEDE
SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.dex: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails. Then it finishes them off with deadly poison.

SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE_MEGA.name: SCOLIPEDE
SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE_MEGA.dex: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

SPECIES_COTTONEE.name: COTTONEE
SPECIES_COTTONEE.dex: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.name: WHIMSICOTT
SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.dex: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

SPECIES_PETILIL.name: PETILIL
SPECIES_PETILIL.dex: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

SPECIES_LILLIGANT.name: LILLIGANT
SPECIES_LILLIGANT.dex: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

SPECIES_LILLIGANT_HISUI.name: LILLIGANT-H
SPECIES_LILLIGANT_HISUI.dex: Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.name: BASCULIN
SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.dex: It used to be a common food source. The meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side and it's more popular with the youth. Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.

SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.name: BASCULIN
SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.dex: They form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin. Its flavor is light and inoffensive.

SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.name: BASCULIN
SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.dex: While this ancient form of Basculin shares a vast array of qualities with other forms, it differs in several respects, including demeanor, being much gentler than others.

SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.name: BASCULEGION
SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.dex: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species in all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.name: BASCULEGION
SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.dex: The souls of its comrades cloak its body and propel it effortlessly through even raging rapids.

SPECIES_SANDILE.name: SANDILE
SPECIES_SANDILE.dex: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

SPECIES_KROKOROK.name: KROKOROK
SPECIES_KROKOROK.dex: They move in groups of a few individuals. Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the dead of night.

SPECIES_KROOKODILE.name: KROOKODILE
SPECIES_KROOKODILE.dex: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

SPECIES_DARUMAKA.name: DARUMAKA
SPECIES_DARUMAKA.dex: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it pulls its limbs into its body and falls asleep.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.name: DARMANITAN
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.dex: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.name: DARMANITAN
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.dex: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

SPECIES_DARUMAKA_GALAR.name: DARUMAKA-G
SPECIES_DARUMAKA_GALAR.dex: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_STANDARD.name: DARMANITAN-G
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_STANDARD.dex: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_ZEN.name: DARMANITAN-G
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_ZEN.dex: Darmanitan takes this form when enraged. It won't stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

SPECIES_MARACTUS.name: MARACTUS
SPECIES_MARACTUS.dex: Arid regions are their habitat. When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

SPECIES_DWEBBLE.name: DWEBBLE
SPECIES_DWEBBLE.dex: It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

SPECIES_CRUSTLE.name: CRUSTLE
SPECIES_CRUSTLE.dex: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle and begins to weaken.

SPECIES_SCRAGGY.name: SCRAGGY
SPECIES_SCRAGGY.dex: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck. Its skull is massively thick.

SPECIES_SCRAFTY.name: SCRAFTY
SPECIES_SCRAFTY.dex: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader, and is the most respected.

SPECIES_SCRAFTY_MEGA.name: SCRAFTY
SPECIES_SCRAFTY_MEGA.dex: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

SPECIES_SIGILYPH.name: SIGILYPH
SPECIES_SIGILYPH.dex: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders. They use their psychic power to attack enemies.

SPECIES_YAMASK.name: YAMASK
SPECIES_YAMASK.dex: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.name: COFAGRIGUS
SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.dex: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

SPECIES_YAMASK_GALAR.name: YAMASK-G
SPECIES_YAMASK_GALAR.dex: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.name: RUNERIGUS
SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.dex: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.name: TIRTOUGA
SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.dex: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas about a hundred million years ago. It was restored from a fossil.

SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.name: CARRACOSTA
SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.dex: They can live both in the ocean and on land. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

SPECIES_ARCHEN.name: ARCHEN
SPECIES_ARCHEN.dex: Said to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.name: ARCHEOPS
SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.dex: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

SPECIES_TRUBBISH.name: TRUBBISH
SPECIES_TRUBBISH.dex: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of this gas will put a person in the hospital.

SPECIES_GARBODOR.name: GARBODOR
SPECIES_GARBODOR.dex: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.name: GARBODOR
SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.dex: It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the way down to your bones.

SPECIES_ZORUA.name: ZORUA
SPECIES_ZORUA.dex: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

SPECIES_ZOROARK.name: ZOROARK
SPECIES_ZOROARK.dex: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

SPECIES_ZORUA_HISUI.name: ZORUA-H
SPECIES_ZORUA_HISUI.dex: Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

SPECIES_ZOROARK_HISUI.name: ZOROARK-H
SPECIES_ZOROARK_HISUI.dex: Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

SPECIES_MINCCINO.name: MINCCINO
SPECIES_MINCCINO.dex: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

SPECIES_CINCCINO.name: CINCCINO
SPECIES_CINCCINO.dex: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that repels dust and helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

SPECIES_GOTHITA.name: GOTHITA
SPECIES_GOTHITA.dex: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

SPECIES_GOTHORITA.name: GOTHORITA
SPECIES_GOTHORITA.dex: Starlight is the source of their power. They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them astray are told in every corner.

SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.name: GOTHITELLE
SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.dex: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power. When it learns its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

SPECIES_SOLOSIS.name: SOLOSIS
SPECIES_SOLOSIS.dex: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

SPECIES_DUOSION.name: DUOSION
SPECIES_DUOSION.dex: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

SPECIES_REUNICLUS.name: REUNICLUS
SPECIES_REUNICLUS.dex: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

SPECIES_DUCKLETT.name: DUCKLETT
SPECIES_DUCKLETT.dex: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

SPECIES_SWANNA.name: SWANNA
SPECIES_SWANNA.dex: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles. The one in the middle is the leader of the flock.

SPECIES_VANILLITE.name: VANILLITE
SPECIES_VANILLITE.dex: The temperature of their breath is -58ºF. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is treasured by households in warm regions.

SPECIES_VANILLISH.name: VANILLISH
SPECIES_VANILLISH.dex: Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

SPECIES_VANILLUXE.name: VANILLUXE
SPECIES_VANILLUXE.dex: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.name: DEERLING
SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.dex: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.name: DEERLING
SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.dex: To prevent Deerling from entering their fields, many farmers will have several Lycanroc stand guard, as they are its natural enemy.

SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.name: DEERLING
SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.dex: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.name: DEERLING
SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.dex: Deerling's scent changes with the seasons, but when the Pokémon is in its Winter Form, it has hardly any scent at all.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.name: SAWSBUCK
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.dex: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.name: SAWSBUCK
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.dex: The thicker and larger the branches and leaves on its antlers, the more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.name: SAWSBUCK
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.dex: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.name: SAWSBUCK
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.dex: Though there are many enthusiasts for Sawsbuck as a species, this seasonal form in particular is not very popular.

SPECIES_EMOLGA.name: EMOLGA
SPECIES_EMOLGA.dex: It glides using its cape-like membrane. It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks from the pouches on its cheeks and makes a meal of them.

SPECIES_KARRABLAST.name: KARRABLAST
SPECIES_KARRABLAST.dex: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. For some reason they evolve while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.name: ESCAVALIER
SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.dex: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances. The steel armor protects their whole body.

SPECIES_FOONGUS.name: FOONGUS
SPECIES_FOONGUS.dex: It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases its poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.name: AMOONGUSS
SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.dex: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

SPECIES_FRILLISH.name: FRILLISH
SPECIES_FRILLISH.dex: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an opponent, that foe will be dragged five miles below the surface to its lair, never to return.

SPECIES_JELLICENT.name: JELLICENT
SPECIES_JELLICENT.dex: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.name: ALOMOMOLA
SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.dex: When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore. The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

SPECIES_JOLTIK.name: JOLTIK
SPECIES_JOLTIK.dex: Since they can't generate their own electricity, they attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in a pouch.

SPECIES_GALVANTULA.name: GALVANTULA
SPECIES_GALVANTULA.dex: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

SPECIES_FERROSEED.name: FERROSEED
SPECIES_FERROSEED.dex: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling of caves. When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes.

SPECIES_FERROTHORN.name: FERROTHORN
SPECIES_FERROTHORN.dex: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

SPECIES_KLINK.name: KLINK
SPECIES_KLINK.dex: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

SPECIES_KLANG.name: KLANG
SPECIES_KLANG.dex: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

SPECIES_KLINKLANG.name: KLINKLANG
SPECIES_KLINKLANG.dex: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

SPECIES_TYNAMO.name: TYNAMO
SPECIES_TYNAMO.dex: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.name: EELEKTRIK
SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.dex: These Pokémon have a big appetite. It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.name: EELEKTROSS
SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.dex: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean, with their sucker mouths.

SPECIES_EELEKTROSS_MEGA.name: EELEKTROSS
SPECIES_EELEKTROSS_MEGA.dex: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this energy from its false Eelektrik made of mucus.

SPECIES_ELGYEM.name: ELGYEM
SPECIES_ELGYEM.dex: It psychically squeezes the brain of its foe, causing unendurable headaches. Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.name: BEHEEYEM
SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.dex: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

SPECIES_LITWICK.name: LITWICK
SPECIES_LITWICK.dex: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

SPECIES_LAMPENT.name: LAMPENT
SPECIES_LAMPENT.dex: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

SPECIES_CHANDELURE.name: CHANDELURE
SPECIES_CHANDELURE.dex: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

SPECIES_CHANDELURE_MEGA.name: CHANDELURE
