SPECIES_CHANDELURE_MEGA.dex: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.

SPECIES_AXEW.name: AXEW
SPECIES_AXEW.dex: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

SPECIES_FRAXURE.name: FRAXURE
SPECIES_FRAXURE.dex: Their tusks can shatter rocks. A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

SPECIES_HAXORUS.name: HAXORUS
SPECIES_HAXORUS.dex: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

SPECIES_CUBCHOO.name: CUBCHOO
SPECIES_CUBCHOO.dex: Its nose is always running. Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

SPECIES_BEARTIC.name: BEARTIC
SPECIES_BEARTIC.dex: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

SPECIES_SHELMET.name: SHELMET
SPECIES_SHELMET.dex: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast.

SPECIES_ACCELGOR.name: ACCELGOR
SPECIES_ACCELGOR.dex: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane. It is very light and fights with ninja-like movements.

SPECIES_STUNFISK.name: STUNFISK
SPECIES_STUNFISK.dex: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

SPECIES_STUNFISK_GALAR.name: STUNFISK-G
SPECIES_STUNFISK_GALAR.dex: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

SPECIES_MIENFOO.name: MIENFOO
SPECIES_MIENFOO.dex: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise. What it lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

SPECIES_MIENSHAO.name: MIENSHAO
SPECIES_MIENSHAO.dex: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.name: DRUDDIGON
SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.dex: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

SPECIES_GOLETT.name: GOLETT
SPECIES_GOLETT.dex: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization. It's been active for thousands of years.

SPECIES_GOLURK.name: GOLURK
SPECIES_GOLURK.dex: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

SPECIES_GOLURK_MEGA.name: GOLURK
SPECIES_GOLURK_MEGA.dex: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.

SPECIES_PAWNIARD.name: PAWNIARD
SPECIES_PAWNIARD.dex: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

SPECIES_BISHARP.name: BISHARP
SPECIES_BISHARP.dex: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.name: KINGAMBIT
SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.dex: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.name: BOUFFALANT
SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.dex: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

SPECIES_RUFFLET.name: RUFFLET
SPECIES_RUFFLET.dex: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

SPECIES_BRAVIARY.name: BRAVIARY
SPECIES_BRAVIARY.dex: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

SPECIES_BRAVIARY_HISUI.name: BRAVIARY-H
SPECIES_BRAVIARY_HISUI.dex: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt.

SPECIES_VULLABY.name: VULLABY
SPECIES_VULLABY.dex: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.name: MANDIBUZZ
SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.dex: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

SPECIES_HEATMOR.name: HEATMOR
SPECIES_HEATMOR.dex: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

SPECIES_DURANT.name: DURANT
SPECIES_DURANT.dex: Durant dig nests in mountains. Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

SPECIES_DEINO.name: DEINO
SPECIES_DEINO.dex: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.name: ZWEILOUS
SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.dex: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves on to another area. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

SPECIES_HYDREIGON.name: HYDREIGON
SPECIES_HYDREIGON.dex: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

SPECIES_LARVESTA.name: LARVESTA
SPECIES_LARVESTA.dex: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. It spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

SPECIES_VOLCARONA.name: VOLCARONA
SPECIES_VOLCARONA.dex: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

SPECIES_COBALION.name: COBALION
SPECIES_COBALION.dex: It has a body and heart of steel. This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

SPECIES_TERRAKION.name: TERRAKION
SPECIES_TERRAKION.dex: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

SPECIES_VIRIZION.name: VIRIZION
SPECIES_VIRIZION.dex: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Legends say this Pokémon used whirlwind-like movements to confound and swiftly cut its opponents.

SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.name: TORNADUS
SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.dex: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power can blow entire houses away. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.name: TORNADUS
SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.dex: An example of what is known as a “form change”. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.

SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.name: THUNDURUS
SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.dex: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.name: THUNDURUS
SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.dex: It pulverizes foes into nothingness with showers of devastatingly powerful lightning bolts launched from the string of orbs on its tail.

SPECIES_RESHIRAM.name: RESHIRAM
SPECIES_RESHIRAM.dex: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

SPECIES_ZEKROM.name: ZEKROM
SPECIES_ZEKROM.dex: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It has a generator that creates electricity in its tail. It assists those with strong ideals.

SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.name: LANDORUS
SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.dex: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, granting bountiful crops. It has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.name: LANDORUS
SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.dex: Landorus soars through the sky in this form, bestowing plentiful harvests upon the land and earning the people's reverence.

SPECIES_KYUREM.name: KYUREM
SPECIES_KYUREM.dex: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals. Its body became frozen when its energy leaked out.

SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.name: KYUREM
SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.dex: The sameness of Reshiram's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can now use the power of both fire and ice.

SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.name: KYUREM
SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.dex: The sameness of Zekrom's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice.

SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.name: KELDEO
SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.dex: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers.

SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.name: KELDEO
SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.dex: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.name: MELOETTA
SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.dex: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad. Many famous songs have been inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.

SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.name: MELOETTA
SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.dex: Meloetta's melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

SPECIES_CHESPIN.name: CHESPIN
SPECIES_CHESPIN.dex: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

SPECIES_QUILLADIN.name: QUILLADIN
SPECIES_QUILLADIN.dex: They strengthen the sturdy shell covering their bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights, but will counterattack with sharp quills.

SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.name: CHESNAUGHT
SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.dex: It shields its allies from danger with its own body. When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it can withstand a bomb blast.

SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT_MEGA.name: CHESNAUGHT
SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT_MEGA.dex: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.

SPECIES_FENNEKIN.name: FENNEKIN
SPECIES_FENNEKIN.dex: As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill itself with energy in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its roomy ears.

SPECIES_BRAIXEN.name: BRAIXEN
SPECIES_BRAIXEN.dex: Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail. When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

SPECIES_DELPHOX.name: DELPHOX
SPECIES_DELPHOX.dex: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future. It uses psychic power to incinerate its foes.

SPECIES_DELPHOX_MEGA.name: DELPHOX
SPECIES_DELPHOX_MEGA.dex: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

SPECIES_FROAKIE.name: FROAKIE
SPECIES_FROAKIE.dex: It protects its skin by covering its body in bubbles it secretes from its chest and back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

SPECIES_FROGADIER.name: FROGADIER
SPECIES_FROGADIER.dex: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness is unparalleled.

SPECIES_GRENINJA_MEGA.name: GRENINJA
SPECIES_GRENINJA_MEGA.dex: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

SPECIES_BUNNELBY.name: BUNNELBY
SPECIES_BUNNELBY.dex: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly. Bunnelby dig the whole night through.

SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.name: DIGGERSBY
SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.dex: With its powerful ears it reduces dense bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help at construction sites. When it's finished digging, it lounges about lazily.

SPECIES_FLETCHLING.name: FLETCHLING
SPECIES_FLETCHLING.dex: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side. It's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.name: FLETCHINDER
SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.dex: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of the grass.

SPECIES_TALONFLAME.name: TALONFLAME
SPECIES_TALONFLAME.dex: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

SPECIES_LITLEO.name: LITLEO
SPECIES_LITLEO.dex: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to start a fight.

SPECIES_PYROAR.name: PYROAR
SPECIES_PYROAR.dex: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride. The females protect the pride's cubs. They viciously threaten any challenger.

SPECIES_PYROAR_MEGA.name: PYROAR
SPECIES_PYROAR_MEGA.dex: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

SPECIES_FLABEBE_ORANGE.name: FLOETTE
SPECIES_FLABEBE_ORANGE.dex: It receives strength from flowers and gives them some of its energy in return. This Pokémon likes orange flowers best of all.

SPECIES_FLOETTE_ETERNAL.name: FLORGES
SPECIES_FLOETTE_ETERNAL.dex: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

SPECIES_FLOETTE_MEGA.name: FLOETTE
SPECIES_FLOETTE_MEGA.dex: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.

SPECIES_SKIDDO.name: SKIDDO
SPECIES_SKIDDO.dex: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back. It has a placid disposition.

SPECIES_GOGOAT.name: GOGOAT
SPECIES_GOGOAT.dex: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

SPECIES_PANCHAM.name: PANCHAM
SPECIES_PANCHAM.dex: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

SPECIES_PANGORO.name: PANGORO
SPECIES_PANGORO.dex: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

SPECIES_ESPURR.name: ESPURR
SPECIES_ESPURR.dex: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.name: MEOWSTIC
SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.dex: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.name: MEOWSTIC
SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.dex: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M_MEGA.name: MEOWSTIC
SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M_MEGA.dex: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F_MEGA.name: MEOWSTIC
SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F_MEGA.dex: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

SPECIES_HONEDGE.name: HONEDGE
SPECIES_HONEDGE.dex: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

SPECIES_DOUBLADE.name: DOUBLADE
SPECIES_DOUBLADE.dex: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords. The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.name: AEGISLASH
SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.dex: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.name: AEGISLASH
SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.dex: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

SPECIES_SPRITZEE.name: SPRITZEE
SPECIES_SPRITZEE.dex: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

SPECIES_AROMATISSE.name: AROMATISSE
SPECIES_AROMATISSE.dex: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

SPECIES_SWIRLIX.name: SWIRLIX
SPECIES_SWIRLIX.dex: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes sticky white threads.

SPECIES_SLURPUFF.name: SLURPUFF
SPECIES_SLURPUFF.dex: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

SPECIES_INKAY.name: INKAY
SPECIES_INKAY.dex: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

SPECIES_MALAMAR.name: MALAMAR
SPECIES_MALAMAR.dex: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids. It forces others to do whatever it wants.

SPECIES_MALAMAR_MEGA.name: MALAMAR
SPECIES_MALAMAR_MEGA.dex: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personality and memories of others-and to control them.

SPECIES_BINACLE.name: BINACLE
SPECIES_BINACLE.dex: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

SPECIES_BARBARACLE.name: BARBARACLE
SPECIES_BARBARACLE.dex: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

SPECIES_BARBARACLE_MEGA.name: BARBARACLE
SPECIES_BARBARACLE_MEGA.dex: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.

SPECIES_SKRELP.name: SKRELP
SPECIES_SKRELP.dex: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution. They spray liquid poison on prey that approach unawares.

SPECIES_DRAGALGE.name: DRAGALGE
SPECIES_DRAGALGE.dex: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker. Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

SPECIES_DRAGALGE_MEGA.name: DRAGALGE
SPECIES_DRAGALGE_MEGA.dex: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.

SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.name: CLAUNCHER
SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.dex: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can even shatter large rocks.

SPECIES_CLAWITZER.name: CLAWITZER
SPECIES_CLAWITZER.dex: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its enormous claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots. They launch cannonballs made of water.

SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.name: HELIOPTILE
SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.dex: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their own energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

SPECIES_HELIOLISK.name: HELIOLISK
SPECIES_HELIOLISK.dex: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper. It can stimulate its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs.

SPECIES_TYRUNT.name: TYRUNT
SPECIES_TYRUNT.dex: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up a car. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.name: TYRANTRUM
SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.dex: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

SPECIES_AMAURA.name: AMAURA
SPECIES_AMAURA.dex: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a cold land where there were no predators.

SPECIES_AURORUS.name: AURORUS
SPECIES_AURORUS.dex: Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its body it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack, or encase them in ice.

SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.name: HAWLUCHA
SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.dex: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. Its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

SPECIES_HAWLUCHA_MEGA.name: HAWLUCHA
SPECIES_HAWLUCHA_MEGA.dex: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

SPECIES_DEDENNE.name: DEDENNE
SPECIES_DEDENNE.dex: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

SPECIES_CARBINK.name: CARBINK
SPECIES_CARBINK.dex: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

SPECIES_GOOMY.name: GOOMY
SPECIES_GOOMY.dex: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

SPECIES_SLIGGOO.name: SLIGGOO
SPECIES_SLIGGOO.dex: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

SPECIES_GOODRA.name: GOODRA
SPECIES_GOODRA.dex: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

SPECIES_SLIGGOO_HISUI.name: SLIGGOO-H
SPECIES_SLIGGOO_HISUI.dex: A creature given to melancholy. Its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

SPECIES_GOODRA_HISUI.name: GOODRA-H
SPECIES_GOODRA_HISUI.dex: It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy--it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

SPECIES_KLEFKI.name: KLEFKI
SPECIES_KLEFKI.dex: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

SPECIES_PHANTUMP.name: PHANTUMP
SPECIES_PHANTUMP.dex: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

SPECIES_TREVENANT.name: TREVENANT
SPECIES_TREVENANT.dex: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.name: PUMPKABOO
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.dex: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.name: PUMPKABOO
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.dex: When taking spirits to the afterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to those of adults.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.name: PUMPKABOO
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.dex: When taking spirits to the afterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to those of children.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.name: PUMPKABOO
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.dex: Supersized Pumpkaboo are very partial to the spirits of people who were of similarly superior proportions.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.name: GOURGEIST
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.dex: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.name: GOURGEIST
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.dex: A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a small-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.name: GOURGEIST
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.dex: A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a large-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.name: GOURGEIST
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.dex: A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves into a supersized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

SPECIES_BERGMITE.name: BERGMITE
SPECIES_BERGMITE.dex: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice. They live in herds on snowy mountains.

SPECIES_AVALUGG.name: AVALUGG
SPECIES_AVALUGG.dex: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

SPECIES_AVALUGG_HISUI.name: AVALUGG-H
SPECIES_AVALUGG_HISUI.dex: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease.

SPECIES_NOIBAT.name: NOIBAT
SPECIES_NOIBAT.dex: They live in pitch-black caves. Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

SPECIES_NOIVERN.name: NOIVERN
SPECIES_NOIVERN.dex: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

SPECIES_YVELTAL.name: YVELTAL
SPECIES_YVELTAL.dex: When its life comes to an end, its wings and tail spread wide and glow red, and it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.

SPECIES_ZYGARDE_COMPLETE.name: ZYGARDE
SPECIES_ZYGARDE_COMPLETE.dex: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.

SPECIES_ZYGARDE_MEGA.name: ZYGARDE
SPECIES_ZYGARDE_MEGA.dex: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.

SPECIES_DIANCIE.name: DIANCIE
SPECIES_DIANCIE.dex: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world. It creates diamonds between its hands.

SPECIES_DIANCIE_MEGA.name: DIANCIE
SPECIES_DIANCIE_MEGA.dex: The impurities upon its body's surface have fallen away, sparkling so brilliantly that cannot be observed directly. It is known as “the Royal Pink Princess”.

SPECIES_HOOPA_CONFINED.name: HOOPA
SPECIES_HOOPA_CONFINED.dex: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. When its powers are sealed away, it is transformed into a much smaller form. It teleports things to a secret place.

SPECIES_HOOPA_UNBOUND.name: HOOPA
SPECIES_HOOPA_UNBOUND.dex: It is the true form of Hoopa, which has had its power sealed away. The rings it carries have the power to bend dimensions and are able to seize anything in the world.

SPECIES_VOLCANION.name: VOLCANION
SPECIES_VOLCANION.dex: It lets out billows of steam from the arms on its back and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

SPECIES_ROWLET.name: ROWLET
SPECIES_ROWLET.dex: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night. Silently it glides, drawing near to its target.

SPECIES_DARTRIX.name: DARTRIX
SPECIES_DARTRIX.dex: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

SPECIES_DECIDUEYE.name: DECIDUEYE
SPECIES_DECIDUEYE.dex: Decidueye is cool and cautious. It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances of over a hundred yards.

SPECIES_DECIDUEYE_HISUI.name: DECIDUEYE-H
SPECIES_DECIDUEYE_HISUI.dex: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold.

SPECIES_LITTEN.name: LITTEN
SPECIES_LITTEN.dex: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

SPECIES_TORRACAT.name: TORRACAT
SPECIES_TORRACAT.dex: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

SPECIES_INCINEROAR.name: INCINEROAR
SPECIES_INCINEROAR.dex: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

SPECIES_POPPLIO.name: POPPLIO
SPECIES_POPPLIO.dex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

SPECIES_BRIONNE.name: BRIONNE
SPECIES_BRIONNE.dex: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance with a sequence of water balloons to try and help.

SPECIES_PRIMARINA.name: PRIMARINA
SPECIES_PRIMARINA.dex: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

SPECIES_PIKIPEK.name: PIKIPEK
SPECIES_PIKIPEK.dex: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth. It uses holes in trees for nesting.

SPECIES_TRUMBEAK.name: TRUMBEAK
SPECIES_TRUMBEAK.dex: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors. It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak.

SPECIES_TOUCANNON.name: TOUCANNON
SPECIES_TOUCANNON.dex: When it battles, within its beak, its internal gases ignite, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

SPECIES_YUNGOOS.name: YUNGOOS
SPECIES_YUNGOOS.dex: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses and falls asleep on the spot.

SPECIES_GRUBBIN.name: GRUBBIN
SPECIES_GRUBBIN.dex: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon, though it normally lives underground.

SPECIES_CHARJABUG.name: CHARJABUG
SPECIES_CHARJABUG.dex: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

SPECIES_CRABRAWLER.name: CRABRAWLER
SPECIES_CRABRAWLER.dex: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE.name: CRABOMINABLE
SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE.dex: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew thick fur.

SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE_MEGA.name: CRABOMINABLE
SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE_MEGA.dex: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.

SPECIES_ORICORIO_BAILE.name: ORICORIO
SPECIES_ORICORIO_BAILE.dex: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

SPECIES_ORICORIO_POM_POM.name: ORICORIO
SPECIES_ORICORIO_POM_POM.dex: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

SPECIES_ORICORIO_PAU.name: ORICORIO
SPECIES_ORICORIO_PAU.dex: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

SPECIES_ORICORIO_SENSU.name: ORICORIO
SPECIES_ORICORIO_SENSU.dex: It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.

SPECIES_CUTIEFLY.name: CUTIEFLY
SPECIES_CUTIEFLY.dex: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers. It can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDDAY.name: LYCANROC
SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDDAY.dex: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.

SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDNIGHT.name: LYCANROC
SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDNIGHT.dex: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

SPECIES_LYCANROC_DUSK.name: LYCANROC
SPECIES_LYCANROC_DUSK.dex: These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. It's said that this form of Lycanroc is the most troublesome to raise.

SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SOLO.name: WISHIWASHI
SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SOLO.dex: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SCHOOL.name: WISHIWASHI
SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SCHOOL.dex: When facing tough opponents, they get into formation. But if they get wounded in battle, they'll scatter and become solitary again.

SPECIES_MAREANIE.name: MAREANIE
SPECIES_MAREANIE.dex: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

SPECIES_TOXAPEX.name: TOXAPEX
SPECIES_TOXAPEX.dex: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

SPECIES_MUDBRAY.name: MUDBRAY
SPECIES_MUDBRAY.dex: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire form its daily routine.

SPECIES_MUDSDALE.name: MUDSDALE
SPECIES_MUDSDALE.dex: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

SPECIES_DEWPIDER.name: DEWPIDER
SPECIES_DEWPIDER.dex: It crawls onto the land in search of food. When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

SPECIES_FOMANTIS.name: FOMANTIS
SPECIES_FOMANTIS.dex: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

SPECIES_MORELULL.name: MORELULL
SPECIES_MORELULL.dex: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

SPECIES_SHIINOTIC.name: SHIINOTIC
SPECIES_SHIINOTIC.dex: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

SPECIES_SALANDIT.name: SALANDIT
SPECIES_SALANDIT.dex: It burns its bodily fluids to create a sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

SPECIES_STUFFUL.name: STUFFUL
SPECIES_STUFFUL.dex: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

SPECIES_BEWEAR.name: BEWEAR
SPECIES_BEWEAR.dex: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

SPECIES_BOUNSWEET.name: BOUNSWEET
SPECIES_BOUNSWEET.dex: A delectable aroma pours from its body.  Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

SPECIES_STEENEE.name: STEENEE
SPECIES_STEENEE.dex: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

SPECIES_TSAREENA.name: TSAREENA
SPECIES_TSAREENA.dex: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

SPECIES_COMFEY.name: COMFEY
SPECIES_COMFEY.dex: It attaches flowers to its nutritious vine. Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

SPECIES_ORANGURU.name: ORANGURU
SPECIES_ORANGURU.dex: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

SPECIES_PASSIMIAN.name: PASSIMIAN
SPECIES_PASSIMIAN.dex: They battle with hard berries for weapons. They form groups of about 20 individuals. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

SPECIES_WIMPOD.name: WIMPOD
SPECIES_WIMPOD.dex: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake. It lives on beaches and seabeds.

SPECIES_GOLISOPOD.name: GOLISOPOD
SPECIES_GOLISOPOD.dex: It battles skillfully with its six arms, with a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater--or even air--right in two.

SPECIES_GOLISOPOD_MEGA.name: GOLISOPOD
SPECIES_GOLISOPOD_MEGA.dex: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.

SPECIES_SANDYGAST.name: SANDYGAST
SPECIES_SANDYGAST.dex: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth, to add to the pile of its sand-mound body. This Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

SPECIES_PALOSSAND.name: PALOSSAND
SPECIES_PALOSSAND.dex: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

SPECIES_PYUKUMUKU.name: PYUKUMUKU
SPECIES_PYUKUMUKU.dex: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

SPECIES_TYPE_NULL.name: TYPE: NULL
SPECIES_TYPE_NULL.dex: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its capabilities. It has some hidden special power.

SPECIES_KOMALA.name: KOMALA
SPECIES_KOMALA.dex: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

SPECIES_TURTONATOR.name: TURTONATOR
SPECIES_TURTONATOR.dex: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point. It gushes fire from its nostrils.

SPECIES_BRUXISH.name: BRUXISH
SPECIES_BRUXISH.dex: It stuns its prey with its psychic powers and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

SPECIES_DRAMPA.name: DRAMPA
SPECIES_DRAMPA.dex: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

SPECIES_DRAMPA_MEGA.name: DRAMPA
SPECIES_DRAMPA_MEGA.dex: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.

SPECIES_DHELMISE.name: DHELMISE
SPECIES_DHELMISE.dex: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

SPECIES_JANGMO_O.name: JANGMO-O
SPECIES_JANGMO_O.dex: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They grow little by little battling one another.

SPECIES_HAKAMO_O.name: HAKAMO-O
SPECIES_HAKAMO_O.dex: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder each time they're regrown. Its scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.

SPECIES_TAPU_KOKO.name: TAPU KOKO
SPECIES_TAPU_KOKO.dex: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

SPECIES_TAPU_LELE.name: TAPU LELE
SPECIES_TAPU_LELE.dex: A fragrant aroma of flowers follows it. As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health.

SPECIES_TAPU_BULU.name: TAPU BULU
SPECIES_TAPU_BULU.dex: It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth. It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around at its enemies.

SPECIES_TAPU_FINI.name: TAPU FINI
SPECIES_TAPU_FINI.dex: People say it can create pure water that will wash away any corruption. The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies.

SPECIES_COSMOG.name: COSMOG
SPECIES_COSMOG.dex: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

SPECIES_COSMOEM.name: COSMOEM
SPECIES_COSMOEM.dex: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell.

SPECIES_SOLGALEO.name: SOLGALEO
SPECIES_SOLGALEO.dex: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

SPECIES_LUNALA.name: LUNALA
SPECIES_LUNALA.dex: When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world. This Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

SPECIES_NIHILEGO.name: NIHILEGO
SPECIES_NIHILEGO.dex: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

SPECIES_BUZZWOLE.name: BUZZWOLE
SPECIES_BUZZWOLE.dex: This life-form called an Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

SPECIES_PHEROMOSA.name: PHEROMOSA
SPECIES_PHEROMOSA.dex: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

SPECIES_XURKITREE.name: XURKITREE
SPECIES_XURKITREE.dex: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

SPECIES_CELESTEELA.name: CELESTEELA
SPECIES_CELESTEELA.dex: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. One kind of Ultra Beast, witnesses saw it flying across the sky by expelling gas from its two arms.

SPECIES_KARTANA.name: KARTANA
SPECIES_KARTANA.dex: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

SPECIES_GUZZLORD.name: GUZZLORD
SPECIES_GUZZLORD.dex: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. But for some reason its droppings have never been found.

SPECIES_NECROZMA.name: NECROZMA
SPECIES_NECROZMA.dex: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

SPECIES_NECROZMA_DUSK_MANE.name: NECROZMA
SPECIES_NECROZMA_DUSK_MANE.dex: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

SPECIES_NECROZMA_DAWN_WINGS.name: NECROZMA
SPECIES_NECROZMA_DAWN_WINGS.dex: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

SPECIES_NECROZMA_ULTRA.name: NECROZMA
SPECIES_NECROZMA_ULTRA.dex: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

SPECIES_MAGEARNA.name: MAGEARNA
SPECIES_MAGEARNA.dex: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL.name: MAGEARNA
SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL.dex: This is its form from almost 500 years ago. Its body is nothing more than a container-its artificial heart is the actual life-form.

SPECIES_MAGEARNA_MEGA.name: MAGEARNA
SPECIES_MAGEARNA_MEGA.dex: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL_MEGA.name: MAGEARNA
SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL_MEGA.dex: A mechanism to remove Magearna's limitations has lain secretly within Magearna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.

SPECIES_MARSHADOW.name: MARSHADOW
SPECIES_MARSHADOW.dex: Able to conceal itself in the shadows of others, it never appears before humans, so its very existence is the stuff of myth. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.

SPECIES_POIPOLE.name: POIPOLE
SPECIES_POIPOLE.dex: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

SPECIES_NAGANADEL.name: NAGANADEL
SPECIES_NAGANADEL.dex: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

SPECIES_STAKATAKA.name: STAKATAKA
SPECIES_STAKATAKA.dex: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life- forms stacked one on top of each other.

SPECIES_BLACEPHALON.name: BLACEPHALON
SPECIES_BLACEPHALON.dex: It slithers toward people and explode its head without warning. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

SPECIES_ZERAORA.name: ZERAORA
SPECIES_ZERAORA.dex: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

SPECIES_ZERAORA_MEGA.name: ZERAORA
SPECIES_ZERAORA_MEGA.dex: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.

SPECIES_MELTAN.name: MELTAN
SPECIES_MELTAN.dex: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

SPECIES_MELMETAL.name: MELMETAL
SPECIES_MELMETAL.dex: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

SPECIES_MELMETAL_GMAX.name: MELMETAL
SPECIES_MELMETAL_GMAX.dex: In a distant land, there are legends about a cyclopean giant. In fact, the giant was a Melmetal that was flooded with Gigantamax energy.

SPECIES_GROOKEY.name: GROOKEY
SPECIES_GROOKEY.dex: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

SPECIES_THWACKEY.name: THWACKEY
SPECIES_THWACKEY.dex: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

SPECIES_RILLABOOM.name: RILLABOOM
SPECIES_RILLABOOM.dex: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

SPECIES_RILLABOOM_GMAX.name: RILLABOOM
SPECIES_RILLABOOM_GMAX.dex: Rillaboom has become one with its forest of drums and continues to lay down beats that shake all of Galar.

SPECIES_SCORBUNNY.name: SCORBUNNY
SPECIES_SCORBUNNY.dex: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

SPECIES_RABOOT.name: RABOOT
SPECIES_RABOOT.dex: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

SPECIES_CINDERACE.name: CINDERACE
SPECIES_CINDERACE.dex: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

SPECIES_CINDERACE_GMAX.name: CINDERACE
SPECIES_CINDERACE_GMAX.dex: Infused with Cinderace's fighting spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and completely roasts opponents.

SPECIES_SOBBLE.name: SOBBLE
SPECIES_SOBBLE.dex: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

SPECIES_DRIZZILE.name: DRIZZILE
SPECIES_DRIZZILE.dex: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

SPECIES_INTELEON.name: INTELEON
SPECIES_INTELEON.dex: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

SPECIES_INTELEON_GMAX.name: INTELEON
SPECIES_INTELEON_GMAX.dex: Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

SPECIES_SKWOVET.name: SKWOVET
SPECIES_SKWOVET.dex: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

SPECIES_GREEDENT.name: GREEDENT
SPECIES_GREEDENT.dex: It stashes berries in its tail--so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

SPECIES_ROOKIDEE.name: ROOKIDEE
SPECIES_ROOKIDEE.dex: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle--even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

SPECIES_CORVISQUIRE.name: CORVISQUIRE
SPECIES_CORVISQUIRE.dex: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT.name: CORVIKNIGHT
SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT.dex: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT_GMAX.name: CORVIKNIGHT
SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT_GMAX.dex: Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

SPECIES_BLIPBUG.name: BLIPBUG
SPECIES_BLIPBUG.dex: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

SPECIES_DOTTLER.name: DOTTLER
SPECIES_DOTTLER.dex: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

SPECIES_ORBEETLE.name: ORBEETLE
SPECIES_ORBEETLE.dex: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

SPECIES_ORBEETLE_GMAX.name: ORBEETLE
SPECIES_ORBEETLE_GMAX.dex: Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has the rest of its body. This Pokémon's intellect and psychic abilities are overpowering.

SPECIES_NICKIT.name: NICKIT
SPECIES_NICKIT.dex: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

SPECIES_THIEVUL.name: THIEVUL
SPECIES_THIEVUL.dex: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

SPECIES_GOSSIFLEUR.name: GOSSIFLEUR
SPECIES_GOSSIFLEUR.dex: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

SPECIES_ELDEGOSS.name: ELDEGOSS
SPECIES_ELDEGOSS.dex: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

SPECIES_WOOLOO.name: WOOLOO
SPECIES_WOOLOO.dex: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

SPECIES_DUBWOOL.name: DUBWOOL
SPECIES_DUBWOOL.dex: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

SPECIES_CHEWTLE.name: CHEWTLE
SPECIES_CHEWTLE.dex: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

SPECIES_DREDNAW.name: DREDNAW
SPECIES_DREDNAW.dex: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

SPECIES_DREDNAW_GMAX.name: DREDNAW
SPECIES_DREDNAW_GMAX.dex: In the Galar region, there's a tale about this Pokémon chewing up a mountain and using the rubble to stop a flood.

SPECIES_YAMPER.name: YAMPER
SPECIES_YAMPER.dex: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

SPECIES_BOLTUND.name: BOLTUND
SPECIES_BOLTUND.dex: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

SPECIES_ROLYCOLY.name: ROLYCOLY
SPECIES_ROLYCOLY.dex: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

SPECIES_CARKOL.name: CARKOL
SPECIES_CARKOL.dex: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

SPECIES_COALOSSAL.name: COALOSSAL
SPECIES_COALOSSAL.dex: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_COALOSSAL_GMAX.name: COALOSSAL
SPECIES_COALOSSAL_GMAX.dex: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon's flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_APPLIN.name: APPLIN
SPECIES_APPLIN.dex: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

SPECIES_FLAPPLE.name: FLAPPLE
SPECIES_FLAPPLE.dex: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

SPECIES_FLAPPLE_GMAX.name: FLAPPLE
SPECIES_FLAPPLE_GMAX.dex: Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it produces much more sweet nectar, and its shape has changed to resemble a giant apple.

SPECIES_APPLETUN.name: APPLETUN
SPECIES_APPLETUN.dex: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

SPECIES_APPLETUN_GMAX.name: APPLETUN
SPECIES_APPLETUN_GMAX.dex: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon's nectar has thickened. The increased viscosity lets the nectar absorb more damage than before.

SPECIES_DIPPLIN.name: DIPPLIN
SPECIES_DIPPLIN.dex: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

SPECIES_HYDRAPPLE.name: HYDRAPPLE
SPECIES_HYDRAPPLE.dex: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

SPECIES_SILICOBRA.name: SILICOBRA
SPECIES_SILICOBRA.dex: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

SPECIES_SANDACONDA.name: SANDACONDA
SPECIES_SANDACONDA.dex: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

SPECIES_SANDACONDA_GMAX.name: SANDACONDA
SPECIES_SANDACONDA_GMAX.dex: Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand now swirl around its body with enough speed and power to pulverize a skyscraper.

SPECIES_CRAMORANT.name: CRAMORANT
SPECIES_CRAMORANT.dex: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GULPING.name: CRAMORANT
SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GULPING.dex: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GORGING.name: CRAMORANT
SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GORGING.dex: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

SPECIES_ARROKUDA.name: ARROKUDA
SPECIES_ARROKUDA.dex: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

SPECIES_BARRASKEWDA.name: BARRASKEWDA
SPECIES_BARRASKEWDA.dex: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

SPECIES_TOXEL.name: TOXEL
SPECIES_TOXEL.dex: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED.name: TOXTRICITY
SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED.dex: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY.name: TOXTRICITY
SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY.dex: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

SPECIES_SIZZLIPEDE.name: SIZZLIPEDE
SPECIES_SIZZLIPEDE.dex: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

SPECIES_CENTISKORCH.name: CENTISKORCH
SPECIES_CENTISKORCH.dex: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

SPECIES_CENTISKORCH_GMAX.name: CENTISKORCH
SPECIES_CENTISKORCH_GMAX.dex: The heat that comes off a Gigantamax Centiskorch may destabilize air currents. Sometimes it can even cause storms.

SPECIES_CLOBBOPUS.name: CLOBBOPUS
SPECIES_CLOBBOPUS.dex: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

SPECIES_GRAPPLOCT.name: GRAPPLOCT
SPECIES_GRAPPLOCT.dex: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

SPECIES_SINISTEA_PHONY.name: SINISTEA
SPECIES_SINISTEA_PHONY.dex: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

SPECIES_SINISTEA_ANTIQUE.name: SINISTEA
SPECIES_SINISTEA_ANTIQUE.dex: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_PHONY.name: POLTEAGEIST
SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_PHONY.dex: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_ANTIQUE.name: POLTEAGEIST
SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_ANTIQUE.dex: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

SPECIES_HATENNA.name: HATENNA
SPECIES_HATENNA.dex: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

SPECIES_HATTREM.name: HATTREM
SPECIES_HATTREM.dex: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

SPECIES_HATTERENE.name: HATTERENE
SPECIES_HATTERENE.dex: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

SPECIES_HATTERENE_GMAX.name: HATTERENE
SPECIES_HATTERENE_GMAX.dex: This Pokémon can read the emotions of creatures over 30 miles away. The minute it senses hostility, it goes on the attack.

SPECIES_IMPIDIMP.name: IMPIDIMP
SPECIES_IMPIDIMP.dex: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

SPECIES_MORGREM.name: MORGREM
SPECIES_MORGREM.dex: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL.name: GRIMMSNARL
SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL.dex: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL_GMAX.name: GRIMMSNARL
SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL_GMAX.dex: Gigantamax energy has caused more hair to sprout all over its body. With the added strength, it can jump over the world's tallest building.

SPECIES_MILCERY.name: MILCERY
SPECIES_MILCERY.dex: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

SPECIES_FALINKS.name: FALINKS
SPECIES_FALINKS.dex: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

SPECIES_FALINKS_MEGA.name: FALINKS
SPECIES_FALINKS_MEGA.dex: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

SPECIES_PINCURCHIN.name: PINCURCHIN
SPECIES_PINCURCHIN.dex: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

SPECIES_SNOM.name: SNOM
SPECIES_SNOM.dex: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

SPECIES_FROSMOTH.name: FROSMOTH
SPECIES_FROSMOTH.dex: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_STONJOURNER.name: STONJOURNER
SPECIES_STONJOURNER.dex: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

SPECIES_EISCUE_ICE.name: EISCUE
SPECIES_EISCUE_ICE.dex: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

SPECIES_EISCUE_NOICE.name: EISCUE
SPECIES_EISCUE_NOICE.dex: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

SPECIES_INDEEDEE_M.name: INDEEDEE
SPECIES_INDEEDEE_M.dex: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

SPECIES_INDEEDEE_F.name: INDEEDEE
SPECIES_INDEEDEE_F.dex: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

SPECIES_MORPEKO_FULL_BELLY.name: MORPEKO
SPECIES_MORPEKO_FULL_BELLY.dex: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

SPECIES_MORPEKO_HANGRY.name: MORPEKO
SPECIES_MORPEKO_HANGRY.dex: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

SPECIES_CUFANT.name: CUFANT
SPECIES_CUFANT.dex: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

SPECIES_COPPERAJAH.name: COPPERAJAH
SPECIES_COPPERAJAH.dex: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

SPECIES_COPPERAJAH_GMAX.name: COPPERAJAH
SPECIES_COPPERAJAH_GMAX.dex: After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.

SPECIES_DRACOZOLT.name: DRACOZOLT
SPECIES_DRACOZOLT.dex: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

SPECIES_ARCTOZOLT.name: ARCTOZOLT
SPECIES_ARCTOZOLT.dex: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

SPECIES_DRACOVISH.name: DRACOVISH
SPECIES_DRACOVISH.dex: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

SPECIES_ARCTOVISH.name: ARCTOVISH
SPECIES_ARCTOVISH.dex: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

SPECIES_DURALUDON.name: DURALUDON
SPECIES_DURALUDON.dex: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

SPECIES_DURALUDON_GMAX.name: DURALUDON
SPECIES_DURALUDON_GMAX.dex: The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even among Steel types. It also has a body structure that's resistant to earthquakes.

SPECIES_ARCHALUDON.name: ARCHALUDON
SPECIES_ARCHALUDON.dex: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

SPECIES_DREEPY.name: DREEPY
SPECIES_DREEPY.dex: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

SPECIES_DRAKLOAK.name: DRAKLOAK
SPECIES_DRAKLOAK.dex: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

SPECIES_DRAGAPULT.name: DRAGAPULT
SPECIES_DRAGAPULT.dex: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

SPECIES_ZACIAN_HERO.name: ZACIAN
SPECIES_ZACIAN_HERO.dex: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

SPECIES_ZACIAN_CROWNED.name: ZACIAN
SPECIES_ZACIAN_CROWNED.dex: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_HERO.name: ZAMAZENTA
SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_HERO.dex: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_CROWNED.name: ZAMAZENTA
SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_CROWNED.dex: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

SPECIES_ETERNATUS.name: ETERNATUS
SPECIES_ETERNATUS.dex: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

SPECIES_ETERNATUS_ETERNAMAX.name: ETERNATUS
SPECIES_ETERNATUS_ETERNAMAX.dex: As a result of Rose's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

SPECIES_KUBFU.name: KUBFU
SPECIES_KUBFU.dex: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE.name: URSHIFU
SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE.dex: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE_GMAX.name: URSHIFU
SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE_GMAX.dex: People call it the embodiment of rage. It's said that this Pokémon's terrifying expression and shout will rid the world of malevolence.

SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE.name: URSHIFU
SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE.dex: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE_GMAX.name: URSHIFU
SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE_GMAX.dex: As it waits for the right moment to unleash its Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a perfect one- legged stance. It won't even twitch.

SPECIES_ZARUDE.name: ZARUDE
SPECIES_ZARUDE.dex: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

SPECIES_ZARUDE_DADA.name: ZARUDE
SPECIES_ZARUDE_DADA.dex: This Zarude's special strength stems from its love and care for an orphaned human child that the Pokémon has raised.

SPECIES_REGIELEKI.name: REGIELEKI
SPECIES_REGIELEKI.dex: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

SPECIES_REGIDRAGO.name: REGIDRAGO
SPECIES_REGIDRAGO.dex: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

SPECIES_GLASTRIER.name: GLASTRIER
SPECIES_GLASTRIER.dex: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon-- anything it wants, it takes by force.

SPECIES_SPECTRIER.name: SPECTRIER
SPECIES_SPECTRIER.dex: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one--it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

SPECIES_CALYREX.name: CALYREX
SPECIES_CALYREX.dex: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

SPECIES_CALYREX_ICE.name: CALYREX
SPECIES_CALYREX_ICE.dex: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

SPECIES_CALYREX_SHADOW.name: CALYREX
SPECIES_CALYREX_SHADOW.dex: It's said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that had bonded with it ran all across the Galar region to bring green to the wastelands.

SPECIES_ENAMORUS_INCARNATE.name: ENAMORUS
SPECIES_ENAMORUS_INCARNATE.dex: Its arrival brings an end to the winter. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across the land.

SPECIES_ENAMORUS_THERIAN.name: ENAMORUS
SPECIES_ENAMORUS_THERIAN.dex: From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and metes out wrathful, ruthless punishment.

SPECIES_SPRIGATITO.name: SPRIGATITO
SPECIES_SPRIGATITO.dex: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

SPECIES_FLORAGATO.name: FLORAGATO
SPECIES_FLORAGATO.dex: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

SPECIES_MEOWSCARADA.name: MEOWSCARADA
SPECIES_MEOWSCARADA.dex: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

SPECIES_FUECOCO.name: FUECOCO
SPECIES_FUECOCO.dex: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

SPECIES_CROCALOR.name: CROCALOR
SPECIES_CROCALOR.dex: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

SPECIES_SKELEDIRGE.name: SKELEDIRGE
SPECIES_SKELEDIRGE.dex: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_QUAXLY.name: QUAXLY
SPECIES_QUAXLY.dex: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

SPECIES_QUAXWELL.name: QUAXWELL
SPECIES_QUAXWELL.dex: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

SPECIES_QUAQUAVAL.name: QUAQUAVAL
SPECIES_QUAQUAVAL.dex: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

SPECIES_LECHONK.name: LECHONK
SPECIES_LECHONK.dex: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_M.name: OINKOLOGNE
SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_M.dex: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_F.name: OINKOLOGNE
SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_F.dex: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

SPECIES_TAROUNTULA.name: TAROUNTULA
SPECIES_TAROUNTULA.dex: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

SPECIES_SPIDOPS.name: SPIDOPS
SPECIES_SPIDOPS.dex: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

SPECIES_NYMBLE.name: NYMBLE
SPECIES_NYMBLE.dex: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

SPECIES_LOKIX.name: LOKIX
SPECIES_LOKIX.dex: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

SPECIES_PAWMI.name: PAWMI
SPECIES_PAWMI.dex: The pads of its paws are electricity- discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

SPECIES_PAWMO.name: PAWMO
SPECIES_PAWMO.dex: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

SPECIES_PAWMOT.name: PAWMOT
SPECIES_PAWMOT.dex: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

SPECIES_TANDEMAUS.name: TANDEMAUS
SPECIES_TANDEMAUS.dex: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_THREE.name: MAUSHOLD
SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_THREE.dex: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_FOUR.name: MAUSHOLD
SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_FOUR.dex: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

SPECIES_FIDOUGH.name: FIDOUGH
SPECIES_FIDOUGH.dex: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

SPECIES_DACHSBUN.name: DACHSBUN
SPECIES_DACHSBUN.dex: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

SPECIES_SMOLIV.name: SMOLIV
SPECIES_SMOLIV.dex: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

SPECIES_DOLLIV.name: DOLLIV
SPECIES_DOLLIV.dex: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh- scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

SPECIES_ARBOLIVA.name: ARBOLIVA
SPECIES_ARBOLIVA.dex: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_GREEN.name: SQUAWKABILLY
SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_GREEN.dex: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_BLUE.name: SQUAWKABILLY
SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_BLUE.dex: The largest of their flocks can contain more than 50 individuals. They fly around towns and forests, searching for food and making a racket.

SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_YELLOW.name: SQUAWKABILLY
SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_YELLOW.dex: These Squawkabilly are hotheaded, and their fighting style is vicious. They'll leap within reach of their foes to engage in close combat.

SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_WHITE.name: SQUAWKABILLY
SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_WHITE.dex: Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings.

SPECIES_NACLI.name: NACLI
SPECIES_NACLI.dex: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

SPECIES_NACLSTACK.name: NACLSTACK
SPECIES_NACLSTACK.dex: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

SPECIES_GARGANACL.name: GARGANACL
SPECIES_GARGANACL.dex: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

SPECIES_CHARCADET.name: CHARCADET
SPECIES_CHARCADET.dex: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

SPECIES_ARMAROUGE.name: ARMAROUGE
SPECIES_ARMAROUGE.dex: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

SPECIES_CERULEDGE.name: CERULEDGE
SPECIES_CERULEDGE.dex: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

SPECIES_TADBULB.name: TADBULB
SPECIES_TADBULB.dex: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

SPECIES_BELLIBOLT.name: BELLIBOLT
SPECIES_BELLIBOLT.dex: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly- button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

SPECIES_WATTREL.name: WATTREL
SPECIES_WATTREL.dex: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

SPECIES_KILOWATTREL.name: KILOWATTREL
SPECIES_KILOWATTREL.dex: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

SPECIES_MASCHIFF.name: MASCHIFF
SPECIES_MASCHIFF.dex: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

SPECIES_MABOSSTIFF.name: MABOSSTIFF
SPECIES_MABOSSTIFF.dex: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

SPECIES_SHROODLE.name: SHROODLE
SPECIES_SHROODLE.dex: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

SPECIES_GRAFAIAI.name: GRAFAIAI
SPECIES_GRAFAIAI.dex: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

SPECIES_BRAMBLIN.name: BRAMBLIN
SPECIES_BRAMBLIN.dex: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST.name: BRAMBLEGHAST
SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST.dex: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

SPECIES_TOEDSCOOL.name: TOEDSCOOL
SPECIES_TOEDSCOOL.dex: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

SPECIES_TOEDSCRUEL.name: TOEDSCRUEL
SPECIES_TOEDSCRUEL.dex: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

SPECIES_KLAWF.name: KLAWF
SPECIES_KLAWF.dex: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

SPECIES_CAPSAKID.name: CAPSAKID
SPECIES_CAPSAKID.dex: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN.name: SCOVILLAIN
SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN.dex: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN_MEGA.name: SCOVILLAIN
SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN_MEGA.dex: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its “necktie” around to wallop its foes.

SPECIES_RELLOR.name: RELLOR
SPECIES_RELLOR.dex: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

SPECIES_RABSCA.name: RABSCA
SPECIES_RABSCA.dex: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

SPECIES_FLITTLE.name: FLITTLE
SPECIES_FLITTLE.dex: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

SPECIES_ESPATHRA.name: ESPATHRA
SPECIES_ESPATHRA.dex: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

SPECIES_TINKATINK.name: TINKATINK
SPECIES_TINKATINK.dex: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.
