SPECIES_TINKATUFF.name: TINKATUFF
SPECIES_TINKATUFF.dex: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

SPECIES_TINKATON.name: TINKATON
SPECIES_TINKATON.dex: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

SPECIES_WIGLETT.name: WIGLETT
SPECIES_WIGLETT.dex: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

SPECIES_WUGTRIO.name: WUGTRIO
SPECIES_WUGTRIO.dex: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

SPECIES_BOMBIRDIER.name: BOMBIRDIER
SPECIES_BOMBIRDIER.dex: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

SPECIES_FINIZEN.name: FINIZEN
SPECIES_FINIZEN.dex: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

SPECIES_PALAFIN_ZERO.name: PALAFIN
SPECIES_PALAFIN_ZERO.dex: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

SPECIES_PALAFIN_HERO.name: PALAFIN
SPECIES_PALAFIN_HERO.dex: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

SPECIES_VAROOM.name: VAROOM
SPECIES_VAROOM.dex: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

SPECIES_REVAVROOM.name: REVAVROOM
SPECIES_REVAVROOM.dex: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

SPECIES_CYCLIZAR.name: CYCLIZAR
SPECIES_CYCLIZAR.dex: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

SPECIES_ORTHWORM.name: ORTHWORM
SPECIES_ORTHWORM.dex: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

SPECIES_GLIMMET.name: GLIMMET
SPECIES_GLIMMET.dex: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

SPECIES_GLIMMORA.name: GLIMMORA
SPECIES_GLIMMORA.dex: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

SPECIES_GLIMMORA_MEGA.name: GLIMMORA
SPECIES_GLIMMORA_MEGA.dex: Glimmora's petals-now larger and separated from its main body-rotate around it to provide defense while cattering poisonous fragments.

SPECIES_GREAVARD.name: GREAVARD
SPECIES_GREAVARD.dex: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

SPECIES_HOUNDSTONE.name: HOUNDSTONE
SPECIES_HOUNDSTONE.dex: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

SPECIES_FLAMIGO.name: FLAMIGO
SPECIES_FLAMIGO.dex: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

SPECIES_CETODDLE.name: CETODDLE
SPECIES_CETODDLE.dex: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

SPECIES_CETITAN.name: CETITAN
SPECIES_CETITAN.dex: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

SPECIES_VELUZA.name: VELUZA
SPECIES_VELUZA.dex: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

SPECIES_DONDOZO.name: DONDOZO
SPECIES_DONDOZO.dex: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY.name: TATSUGIRI
SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY.dex: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY.name: TATSUGIRI
SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY.dex: This Pokémon tricks its opponents by playing dead. It is small and weak, but it uses its smarts to survive.

SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY.name: TATSUGIRI
SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY.dex: It's one of the most intelligent dragon Pokémon. It camouflages itself by inflating its throat sac.

SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY_MEGA.name: TATSUGIRI
SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY_MEGA.dex: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.

SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY_MEGA.name: TATSUGIRI
SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY_MEGA.dex: It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.

SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY_MEGA.name: TATSUGIRI
SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY_MEGA.dex: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.

SPECIES_GREAT_TUSK.name: GREAT TUSK
SPECIES_GREAT_TUSK.dex: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

SPECIES_SCREAM_TAIL.name: SCREAM TAIL
SPECIES_SCREAM_TAIL.dex: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

SPECIES_BRUTE_BONNET.name: BRUTE BONNET
SPECIES_BRUTE_BONNET.dex: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

SPECIES_FLUTTER_MANE.name: FLUTTER MANE
SPECIES_FLUTTER_MANE.dex: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

SPECIES_SLITHER_WING.name: SLITHER WING
SPECIES_SLITHER_WING.dex: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

SPECIES_SANDY_SHOCKS.name: SANDY SHOCKS
SPECIES_SANDY_SHOCKS.dex: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

SPECIES_IRON_TREADS.name: IRON TREADS
SPECIES_IRON_TREADS.dex: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

SPECIES_IRON_BUNDLE.name: IRON BUNDLE
SPECIES_IRON_BUNDLE.dex: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

SPECIES_IRON_HANDS.name: IRON HANDS
SPECIES_IRON_HANDS.dex: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

SPECIES_IRON_JUGULIS.name: IRON JUGULIS
SPECIES_IRON_JUGULIS.dex: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

SPECIES_IRON_MOTH.name: IRON MOTH
SPECIES_IRON_MOTH.dex: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

SPECIES_IRON_THORNS.name: IRON THORNS
SPECIES_IRON_THORNS.dex: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

SPECIES_FRIGIBAX.name: FRIGIBAX
SPECIES_FRIGIBAX.dex: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

SPECIES_ARCTIBAX.name: ARCTIBAX
SPECIES_ARCTIBAX.dex: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR.name: BAXCALIBUR
SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR.dex: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR_MEGA.name: BAXCALIBUR
SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR_MEGA.dex: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_CHEST.name: GIMMIGHOUL
SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_CHEST.dex: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_ROAMING.name: GIMMIGHOUL
SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_ROAMING.dex: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

SPECIES_GHOLDENGO.name: GHOLDENGO
SPECIES_GHOLDENGO.dex: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

SPECIES_WO_CHIEN.name: WO-CHIEN
SPECIES_WO_CHIEN.dex: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

SPECIES_CHIEN_PAO.name: CHIEN-PAO
SPECIES_CHIEN_PAO.dex: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

SPECIES_TING_LU.name: TING-LU
SPECIES_TING_LU.dex: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

SPECIES_CHI_YU.name: CHI-YU
SPECIES_CHI_YU.dex: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

SPECIES_ROARING_MOON.name: ROARING MOON
SPECIES_ROARING_MOON.dex: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to Mega Evolution that occurs in Hoenn.

SPECIES_IRON_VALIANT.name: IRON VALIANT
SPECIES_IRON_VALIANT.dex: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

SPECIES_KORAIDON.name: KORAIDON
SPECIES_KORAIDON.dex: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

SPECIES_MIRAIDON.name: MIRAIDON
SPECIES_MIRAIDON.dex: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an Violet Book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

SPECIES_WALKING_WAKE.name: WALKING WAKE
SPECIES_WALKING_WAKE.dex: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old journal.

SPECIES_IRON_LEAVES.name: IRON LEAVES
SPECIES_IRON_LEAVES.dex: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_COUNTERFEIT.name: POLTCHAGEIST
SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_COUNTERFEIT.dex: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_ARTISAN.name: POLTCHAGEIST
SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_ARTISAN.dex: It has taken up residence in a very expensive tea caddy. It takes an expert to distinguish the expensive tea caddies from the cheap ones.

SPECIES_SINISTCHA_UNREMARKABLE.name: SINISTCHA
SPECIES_SINISTCHA_UNREMARKABLE.dex: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

SPECIES_SINISTCHA_MASTERPIECE.name: SINISTCHA
SPECIES_SINISTCHA_MASTERPIECE.dex: The more stirring it does with the tea whisk on its head, the more energy it builds up. It does this to prepare for battle.

SPECIES_OKIDOGI.name: OKIDOGI
SPECIES_OKIDOGI.dex: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

SPECIES_MUNKIDORI.name: MUNKIDORI
SPECIES_MUNKIDORI.dex: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

SPECIES_FEZANDIPITI.name: FEZANDIPITI
SPECIES_FEZANDIPITI.dex: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

SPECIES_GOUGING_FIRE.name: GOUGING FIRE
SPECIES_GOUGING_FIRE.dex: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging, and spouting pillars of flame.

SPECIES_RAGING_BOLT.name: RAGING BOLT
SPECIES_RAGING_BOLT.dex: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranomal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

SPECIES_IRON_BOULDER.name: IRON BOULDER
SPECIES_IRON_BOULDER.dex: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

SPECIES_IRON_CROWN.name: IRON CROWN
SPECIES_IRON_CROWN.dex: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like Cobalion.

SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_NORMAL.name: TERAPAGOS
SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_NORMAL.dex: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_TERASTAL.name: TERAPAGOS
SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_TERASTAL.dex: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move's energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_STELLAR.name: TERAPAGOS
SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_STELLAR.dex: An old expedition journal describes the sight of this Pokémon buried in the, depths of the earth as resembling a planet floating in space.

SPECIES_PECHARUNT.name: PECHARUNT
SPECIES_PECHARUNT.dex: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.
